section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1979
title: 36 decline were Bihar (71·1%), Meghalaya (49·1%), Madhya Pradesh (43·6%), Jammu & Kashmir (42·5%), Rajasthan (29·8%) Nagaland (25·0%), Gujarat (24·6%), West Bengal (16·9), Assam (8·5%), Haryana (8·5%) and Maharashtra (1·8%). The incidence of suicides for the Union Territories as a whole recorded a decline of 2·5 percent in 1979 over 1978. Out of 9 Union Territories, 5 registered an increase in total number of suicides in 1979 over 1978 and these were Mizoram (175·0%), Delhi (62·4%), D. & N. Haveli (50·0%), A. & N. Islands (15·8%) and Goa Daman & Diu (11·4%). The remaining 4 U. Ts. which registered a decline were Lakshadweep (100·0%), Pondicherry (49·8%), Arunachal Pradesh (45·5%) and Chandigarh (31·6%).
